characterization: For three months this household has cooked the same four dishes on a loop: the cold-proof focaccia, the long-cooked white beans, smashed potatoes and weighted cabbage. Nothing else ever gets past the ingredient list — every opened-and-closed recipe was shut at step 0, before a single instruction was attempted. The four things they abandon (chicken under a brick, pressed pork belly, beans and greens with pancetta, green sauce with anchovy) are the four that ask them to buy meat or fish, and the two dairy dishes they never opened at all. They have never once opened the technique material, which is not a skill problem: they cook weighted cabbage happily, which is the same weighted-pan move as the chicken and the pork they keep walking away from.
salientInference: Across the last ninety days you closed every meat-or-fish recipe at the ingredient list — yet you cook that same weighted-pan technique meatless.

signals.rhythm: Weekend pot-and-oven work — beans, focaccia, potatoes — with a fast single-pan dish midweek
